newsitem.title: USA: RISCORP says to delay filing of 10-Q.
newsitem.headline: RISCORP says to delay filing of 10-Q.

text.p: RISCORP Inc said on Friday that it will delay the filing to the company's first quarter 10-Q report with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
"While the company regrets the delay, it believes its first quarter 1997 results, as well as its full year 1996 results, will be profitable," RISCORP said in a statement.

RISCORP said it plans on filing its first quarter 10-Q as soon as possible after the filing of its 10-K annual report for 1996, which has been delayed pending completion of the company's final audit for that year.
